title: Because he lives
lyrics_synced:
[00:10.96] God sent His Son,
[00:15.13] they called Him Jesus,
[00:19.30] He came to love,
[00:23.48] heal and forgive;
[00:27.65] He lived and died
[00:31.83] to buy my pardon,
[00:36.00] An empty grave is there
[00:39.13] to prove my Savior lives.
[00:44.35] Because He lives
[00:48.52] I can face tomorrow,
[00:52.70] Because He lives all fear is gone;
[01:01.04] Because I know He holds the future,
[01:09.39] And life is worth the living
[01:13.04] just because He lives.
[01:17.74] How sweet to hold a newborn baby
[01:26.09] and feel the pride and joy he gives;
[01:34.43] But greater still the calm assurance:
[01:42.78] This child can face uncertain days
[01:47.22] because He lives.
[01:51.13] Because He lives
[01:55.30] I can face tomorrow,
[01:59.48] Because He lives
[02:03.65] all fear is gone;
[02:07.83] Because I know
[02:12.00] He holds the future,
[02:16.17] And life is worth the living
[02:19.83] just because He lives.
[02:24.52] And then one day I'll cross the river,
[02:32.87] I'll fight life's final war with pain;
[02:41.22] And then as death gives way to vict'ry,
[02:49.57] I'll see the lights of glory and
[02:54.00] I'll know He lives.
[02:57.91] Because He lives
[03:02.09] I can face tomorrow,
[03:06.26] Because He lives
[03:10.43] all fear is gone;
[03:14.61] Because I know
[03:18.78] He holds the future,
[03:22.96] And life is worth the living
[03:26.61] just because He lives.
[03:31.30] And life is worth the living
[03:34.96] just because He lives.
